channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Decisão do STF causa confusão em locais de votação: 'Não tem como reabrir'
item.description: The STF decision to extend voting hours caused confusion in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Belo Horizonte, with voters unable to cast ballots after 6 PM and poll workers lacking clear guidance. Minister Cristiano Zanin was mentioned as responsible for the ruling.

item.title: Para que o TSE se um ministro do STF pode mudar as regras do jogo? Questiona Sóstenes
item.description: Sóstenes Cavalcante, the PL leader in the Chamber of Deputies, questioned the Supreme Court's role after Justice Cristiano Zanin ordered the extension of voting hours until 7 PM nationwide, accusing the STF of undue interference in the electoral process.

item.title: Em Salvador, seções chegaram a reabrir portões após decisão de Zanin
item.description: In Salvador, some polling stations reopened after Minister Cristiano Zanin, of the Brazilian Supreme Court, extended voting hours until 7 PM nationwide. Meanwhile, other locations had already closed, making it impossible to accept new votes in those areas.

item.title: Resultados de las elecciones en Brasil, en vivo|Cierran las urnas en Brasil y empieza el conteo de votos
item.description: Polling stations closed across Brazil on Sunday, marking the start of vote counting in the most competitive presidential runoff in the nation's history. The race pits President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with polls indicating a technical tie following Bolsonaro's unexpected victory in the first round.

item.title: Decisão de Zanin exige explicações claras, diz Tarcísio
item.description: The governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas, criticized Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend the vote, demanding clarifications on its basis and execution. He emphasized the need for respect, transparency, and legal certainty in Brazil.

item.title: Marçal critica prorrogação da votação e questiona decisão do STF
item.description: Pablo Marçal criticized the extension of voting hours for the second round of elections and questioned the Supreme Federal Court's decision, arguing that the measure would not be necessary nationwide.

item.title: Após prorrogação, Lula e aliados pedem que eleitores votem
item.description: President Lula and allies urged voters to cast ballots after Supreme Court extended voting hours to 7 PM nationwide due to public transportation shortages affecting at least nine states.

item.title: Eleições: PGR foi contra estender horário de votação para 19h na Bahia
item.description: The Deputy Attorney General for Electoral Matters, Alexandre Espinosa Bravo Barbosa, opposed extending voting hours to 7 PM in Bahia, advocating for maintaining the legal 5 PM deadline and investigating the facts. Despite this, Supreme Federal Court Minister Cristiano Zanin decided to extend voting hours until 7 PM nationwide. Zanin's decision particularly affected cases involving transportation and logistical failures, such as in Salvador, which led to the arrest of Municipal Mobility Secretary Pablo Souza.

item.title: Tarcísio nega problemas de transporte em SP e critica decisão de Zanin de estender votação
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas denied public transportation issues and criticized Minister Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend voting hours until 7 PM, accusing the judiciary of institutionalizing the crisis. He claimed the narrative of transportation failures is an attempt to create controversy before the elections.

item.title: Eleitores da BA e SP ficam sem votar por urnas fechadas, apesar de horário
item.description: Voters in Salvador and São Paulo were prevented from casting ballots despite a last-minute extension of voting hours to 7 PM ordered by Supreme Court justice Cristiano Zanin. Videos show sealed polling stations and lack of public transport. The ruling applies only to sites where voting had not yet finished.

item.title: AO VIVO resultado das eleições 2026 – acompanhe a apuração da disputa entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Over 158.7 million eligible voters in Brazil head to the polls for the 2026 second-round elections, featuring a presidential race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Gubernatorial races in six states are also on the ballot. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm, with live coverage starting at 4pm on YouTube and the JOTA website.

item.title: Mesários "perdidos" esperam orientação sobre reabertura de urnas em SP
item.description: Following the STF decision to extend voting hours from 5 PM to 7 PM, several polling stations in São Paulo kept their doors closed due to lack of guidance from the Regional Electoral Court (TRE). Poll workers reported confusion and uncertainty, closing the ballot boxes without knowing whether they should reopen, as the TRE had not specifically informed the affected zones. The decision was prompted by complaints of reduced bus fleets, but communication delays caused frustration among voters and poll workers.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro condenam decisão de Zanin de ampliar horário de votação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies criticized STF minister Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend voting hours, accusing Lula's campaign of interference and threatening to challenge the election if they lose.

item.title: Após prorrogação da votação, Lula encontra apoiadores; veja imagens
item.description: After the extension of voting in the second round of the 2026 presidential election, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) left his residence in Alto de Pinheiros, São Paulo, to take photos with supporters gathered outside his home. The departure occurred after the decision of Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin to extend the voting deadline to 7 PM. The moment reflects a climate of anticipation and gathering of allies among supporters.

item.title: Famosos votam no 2º turno das eleições; veja fotos
item.description: Celebrities like Gilberto Gil, Ludmilla, and Pabllo Vittar voted in the 2026 runoff election choosing between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Five states also have gubernatorial races. The stars shared voting photos and receipts on social media.

item.title: Eleições 2026: substituição de urnas eletrônicas no 2° turno vai para 1.516
item.description: 1,516 electronic voting machines were replaced in the second round of the 2026 elections, representing 0.28% of the total 499,248 devices. Despite the high number of replacements, this does not justify extending voting hours to 7 PM, as decided by the Supreme Court.

item.title: TSE diz que contagem dos votos será retomada às 19h
item.description: The TSE announced that vote counting for the runoff will resume at 7 PM, following Minister Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend voting hours by two hours. Counting was suspended at 5:06 PM with only 1,225 of 499,248 sections counted. Voting continues only in sections that remained open after the STF ruling.

item.title: Advogado de Trump questiona eleição após Zanin ampliar votação até as 19h
item.description: Lawyer Martin De Luca, representing companies linked to Donald Trump, criticized Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend voting hours until 7 PM, questioning the speed of the ruling and raising election manipulation suspicions. The extension was granted after Lula requested it due to public transport issues in several cities. De Luca compared Lula to Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and questioned the election's legitimacy.

item.title: Prorrogação de votação deixa eleitor e mesários "perdidos" em seções no DF
item.description: The Supreme Court's decision to extend voting hours caused chaos at polling stations in Brasília, with equipment shutdown and confusion over procedures. The local electoral court refused to extend voting time, leaving late voters unable to cast ballots. Some voters who arrived after the cutoff were turned away despite the federal court ruling.

item.title: Zanin esclarece que prorrogação da votação até 19h será apenas em seções em que urna não foi fechada
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin ruled that the voting extension until 7 PM will only apply to polling stations where the ballots had not yet been closed. The injunction responded to requests from Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ticket, which reported logistical issues such as bus shortages in Salvador and São Paulo. The PSL also requested the deadline extension.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute prolongamento da votação no Brasil
item.description: International media highlighted the extension of voting hours in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, decided by the Supreme Federal Court after reports of logistical issues and heavy rains. Newspapers from Portugal, Argentina, Spain, the UK, and the US covered the decision and underscored the vote's relevance for Latin America and the world.

item.title: Senador eleito apresenta pedido de impeachment contra ministro Zanin
item.description: Elected Senator Marcel van Hattem (Novo) filed an impeachment request against Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin, accusing him of misconduct for extending the voting hours during the general election runoff. Van Hattem claims the decision was made after the electoral process had already legally concluded and raises bias concerns, noting Zanin was Lula's former personal lawyer.

item.title: TSE diz que votação segue até as 19h apenas em locais onde processo não foi encerrado
item.description: The TSE confirmed that voting continues until 7 PM only in locations where the electoral process had not been concluded by 5 PM, following a decision by Minister Cristiano Zanin of the STF. The measure aims to ensure the continuation of the election in precincts still in progress.

item.title: TSE diz que vai retomar divulgação dos resultados da eleição depois das 19h, ao fim da votação
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) announced the resumption of electoral result disclosure after 7 PM, following Minister Cristiano Zanin's decision to extend voting by two hours due to allegations of voter transport issues. The count was paused with only 0.25% of polling stations reported and remains suspended while ministers await the conclusion of the extended voting period.

item.title: Questões técnicas e de imparcialidade impedem reabertura de urnas, diz ex-ministro do TSE
item.description: Former TSE minister Admar Gonzaga stated that reopening already closed electronic ballot boxes is technically impossible and undermines electoral impartiality, following the Supreme Court's extension of voting hours. He emphasized that electoral security prevents reopening sealed ballot boxes, reaffirming the importance of impartiality and democracy.

item.title: Quem está ganhando a eleição para presidente? Acompanhe a apuração dos votos
item.description: O GLOBO provides real-time coverage of the vote count for president in the second round of the 2026 elections, between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Voting hours were extended nationwide until 7 PM due to public transportation issues. The coverage features a vote evolution chart and gubernatorial results in six states.

item.title: Sem ser notificado pelo TSE, TRE decidiu não prorrogar votação no DF
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District (TRE-DF) decided not to extend voting hours since it did not receive official notification from the TSE regarding the nationwide extension. Although the TSE ruled to extend the election by two hours across the country, the Federal District will not follow the measure due to poll worker demobilization and the impossibility of reopening closed ballot boxes. The court described the decision as abrupt, citing insufficient time to reorganize.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas chega ao local de apuração para acompanhar com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) visited the vote-counting site for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign in Brasília to monitor election results. The visit took place on the evening of October 25, 2026.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Jair Bolsonaro a receber visita de grupo de oração
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest after conviction for attempted coup d'état, to receive visits from a prayer group at his residence. The decision was based on humanitarian and religious freedom criteria. This case reinforces the debate on rights of convicted prisoners and limits of house arrest in Brazil.

item.title: Jovens usam camisa com foto de Flávio e alusão a nazismo e fascismo no MA
item.description: Three young people were identified for wearing shirts with Nazi phrases and praise for fascism during a motorcycle parade supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in Grajaú (MA). The Military Police are investigating the case, which involved Nazi and fascist references in the state electoral context.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE extensão do horário de votação até 19h em mais 9 Estados além da Bahia
item.description: The PT party requested the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in nine additional states beyond Bahia, citing benefits for working voters. The measure was submitted by the coalition 'Brasil Pronto Pra Mais,' led by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The request aims to facilitate voter access in regions with higher population concentration.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para ampliar horário de votação em cidades de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed extending voting hours in cities across São Paulo state to facilitate voter access. The measure aims to reduce long lines and boost popular participation at the polls.

item.title: Coligação de Lula aciona TSE para estender votação até as 19h em cidades de 9 estados
item.description: Lula's coalition filed an urgent petition with the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in cities across nine states. The measure aims to ensure broader access to voting for voters who work outside the home during the day. The petition follows complaints of long lines and difficulties during commercial hours.

item.title: Jovem de 17 anos leva soco durante discussão política em Lisboa
item.description: A 17-year-old girl was assaulted during a political argument in Lisbon, Portugal, while showing support for Lula da Silva. The incident, captured on video, was condemned by the Brazilian consul general in Lisbon and is under formal investigation.

item.title: Pedro Rousseff e assessor ficam feridos em acidente em MG: "Muita chuva"
item.description: Elected federal deputy Pedro Rousseff (PT-MG) and his advisor Gabriel Gerdulino were injured in an accident on the Fernão Dias highway in Itatiaiuçu (MG), caused by heavy rain that made the driver lose control of the vehicle. Both were rescued and taken to a hospital, where they are recovering from minor injuries. The spokesperson said the car was completely destroyed, and further updates will be released as needed.

item.title: Lula confirma pedido ao TSE por prorrogação do horário de votação
item.description: Lula asks the TSE to extend voting hours in cities with reduced public transport, such as Salvador, where the mobility secretary was arrested for cutting the bus fleet. The PT claims transport delays and third-party actions hinder voters, demanding measures to ensure a fair election. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is not directly mentioned regarding the request, only in first-round results.

item.title: "Não vamos aceitar banditismo", diz Lula sobre denúncias de frota reduzida
item.description: Lula asked the TSE to extend voting hours in São Paulo following accusations of reduced bus fleets, blaming mayors, governors, and businessmen for obstructing voter access. He compared the situation to 2022 PRF roadblocks and called for the arrest of municipal officials. The TRE-SP demanded immediate information on bus operations.

item.title: Onde acompanhar a apuração dos votos para presidente? Veja resultado ao vivo
item.description: Live vote counting for the 2026 presidential runoff will be streamed on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM, featuring official data from the TSE. The candidates are Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The platform will also display gubernatorial results in the six states holding simultaneous elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: resultados da apuração do segundo turno para governador do Rio Grande do Norte
item.description: Vote counting for the Rio Grande do Norte gubernatorial runoff in the 2026 elections will be streamed live on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM, with real-time updates integrated with the TSE. The dashboard will show vote percentages, counted polling stations, abstention data, and an interactive map of results by city and electoral zone.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Número de urnas substituídas no 2º turno sobe para 1.351
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court reported that 1,351 electronic voting machines were replaced in the second round of the 2026 elections by 3:30 PM, representing 0.25% of the total 499,248 machines. The states with the most replacements were São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Paraná. Lula's campaign requested extended voting hours in 10 states due to voters' transportation difficulties.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede prorrogação de votação; decisão caberá a Nunes Marques
item.description: The Brazil Hope Federation, led by the PT, requested the TSE to extend voting until 19h in nine states due to voter mobility issues in the second round. The decision rests with Minister Kassio Nunes Marques based on information from the Bahia Regional Electoral Court. The federation also requested the arrest of those responsible for obstructing voting.

item.title: Quem está ganhando a eleição?
item.description: Brazilians elect president in runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Real-time count available on g1 with TSE data.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede que votação seja estendida em cidades de mais nove estados, além da Bahia
item.description: The re-election campaign of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva requested the TSE to extend voting in municipalities of nine additional states beyond Bahia. The request aims to ensure more voting time in high-demand areas. Voting extensions do not directly affect the content of candidate proposals.

item.title: Flávio acompanha apuração com Tarcísio, Zucco e outros aliados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, will spend election night in Brasília watching the runoff vote count against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, joined by political allies including São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, Mayor Ricardo Nunes, and elected governors such as Luciano Zucco and others.

item.title: Quem ganhou as eleições 2026 no exterior? Veja diferença do 1º e 2º turno entre Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: In 2026, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) won the overseas elections in 33 countries, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured 12 nations. Results were gradually released, showing slight variations between the first and second rounds, with Lula's victory standing out in New Zealand and Australia.

item.title: Lula vence em Portugal com 59,4% dos votos válidos; Flávio, 40,6%
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) defeated Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in Portugal with 59.4% of valid votes in the 2026 overseas runoff. Portugal is the second country with the most Brazilian voters abroad, behind only the United States, and Lula also leads in other nations such as France, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.

item.title: Eleições 2026: resultados da apuração do segundo turno para governador do Distrito Federal
item.description: O GLOBO website provides live results for the DF governor runoff election starting at 5 PM on October 25th, updating in real time as data is published by the TSE. Voters can track vote percentages, counted polling stations, blank and null ballots, and view the voting map by electoral zone in Brasília.

item.title: Nunes Marques pede que TRE-BA preste informações em meia hora sobre redução da frota de ônibus em Salvador
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the TRE-BA and PGE to provide information within thirty minutes regarding the reduction of the bus fleet in Salvador, which hinders voters' access to polling stations. Lula's campaign requested an extension of the voting period until 7 PM in the three affected cities. Nunes Marques is still reviewing the request, noting potential impacts on the national tally timeline.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE extensão da votação após crise dos ônibus na Bahia
item.description: The coalition Brazil of Hope Federation (PT/PCdoB/PV) requested the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in Salvador, Feira de Santana, and Lauro de Freitas due to a bus shortage that hindered voter access. The request was submitted by the chief electoral officer, Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: o resultado da votação em Israel e Palestina no segundo turno
item.description: In the second round, Lula secured 95.6% of valid votes in Ramallah, while Flávio Bolsonaro received 4.4%. In Tel Aviv, Flávio led with 80.8% of the votes, underscoring their opposing stances on the Gaza conflict. The results highlight the impact of foreign policy on voter preferences.
